description: The research conductor declared a mandatory specialist unavailable before inspecting all callable internal agent interfaces. A later inspection found a suitable internal bounded-agent interface, so the availability blocker was false.
practical_impact: The research route stopped unnecessarily at a mandatory concept review even though the runtime could have invoked the required specialist without opening another user-visible window.

resolution_options.label: Enforce a capability preflight.
resolution_options.consequence: Every specialist route records and validates live invocation capabilities; a suitable internal interface must be used and only proven unavailability may block.

resolution_options.label: Retain prose-only checking.
resolution_options.consequence: The framework remains vulnerable to another false blocker because the availability claim has no route-bound evidence or regression guard.
